article.title: Voting rights.
article.content:
378ZVoting rights.

Section 378Z  ·  Chapter XXIA  ·  Part III  ·  page 213 of the Act
Save as otherwise provided in sub-sections (1) and (3) of section 378D, every Member shall have one vote and in the case of equality of votes, the Chairman or the person presiding shall have a casting vote except in the case of election of the Chairman.
